architecture.label: Architecture Lab
architecture.title: Designing the system before writing the code
architecture.intro: Four ways to assemble the same application. Pick a view, click a component: responsibilities, technologies, exposed routes and a code snippet.

diagram.hint: Click a component to see its role in detail.

monolith.name: MVC / Monolith
monolith.description: One application, clean layers: the controller receives, the service decides, the repository persists. This is the academic baseline — and the foundation you must master before splitting anything.

rest.name: Spring Boot REST API
rest.description: Front and back are separated and talk over HTTP. Spring Security and JWT filter every request before it reaches the business logic.

microservices.name: Microservices
microservices.description: Two autonomous services behind a single REST façade. Each owns its domain; the façade authenticates once, then routes.

deployment.name: Docker / Deployment
deployment.description: From automated checks to a running container: what turns a Git repository into a reachable application.

frontend.name: Frontend
frontend.description: The user interface. It holds no business rule: it renders, collects and forwards.
responsibilities: Sending the token with every request

controller.name: MVC controller
controller.description: The monolith's HTTP entry point. It turns a request into a service call and picks the view to render.

serviceLayer.name: Service layer
serviceLayer.description: Where the rules live. An agreement is not approved in a controller: it is approved here, inside a transaction.

repository.name: Repository / JPA
repository.description: Data access, isolated behind an interface. The rest of the code never knows there is SQL underneath.

api.name: REST API
api.description: The HTTP façade. It exposes resources, validates input and returns explicit statuses.

security.name: Spring Security
security.description: The filter that runs before everything else. It rejects an unauthenticated request without the business logic ever being reached.

jwt.name: JWT
jwt.description: The signed token carrying identity and roles. No server-side session: the token is enough.

conventionService.name: Conventions service
conventionService.description: The agreements domain: lifecycle, approval, history. It knows nothing about documents.

documentService.name: Documents service
documentService.description: The attachments domain: upload, retrieval, deletion. It knows nothing about agreements.

postgres.name: PostgreSQL
postgres.description: The source of truth. Constraints live in the database, not only in the code.

cicd.name: CI / CD
cicd.description: What verifies before shipping: build, tests, quality. A failure blocks the deployment.

dockerImage.name: Docker image
dockerImage.description: A multi-stage build: compile in a heavy image, ship only a minimal JRE.

appContainer.name: Application container
appContainer.description: The running application, with its health check and environment variables.

dbContainer.name: PostgreSQL container
dbContainer.description: The database in a container, isolated from the public network and reachable only by the application.

volume.name: Persistent volume
volume.description: What outlives the container. Without it, a restart would wipe the data.

roadmap.label: Roadmap
roadmap.title: A project is more than its code
roadmap.intro: Ten stages, from the first analysis to maintenance. Pick a project, click a stage: what it produces, with which tools, and where I stand.
roadmap.hint: Click a stage to see what it produces.

idea.name: Idea / Analysis
idea.description: Understanding the need before writing anything: who the tool serves, which problem it replaces, what already exists.

spec.name: Specification
spec.description: Turning the need into verifiable requirements. A requirement you cannot test is not one.

uml.name: UML design
uml.description: Laying out objects, their relationships and the flows before coding. A wrong diagram costs an hour; a wrong model costs the project.

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.description: Deciding the split: layered monolith or separate services, where the boundaries run, how components talk to each other.

database.name: Database
database.description: Modelling the data and putting the constraints in the database, not only in the code.

development.name: Development
development.description: Writing the code in shippable increments. Every increment must be demonstrable.

tests.name: Testing
tests.description: Checking what was promised at the specification stage, and measuring the quality of the code produced.

cicd.name: CI / CD
cicd.description: Automating verification and delivery: a failure must block the release, not merely slow it down.

deployment.name: Deployment
deployment.description: Shipping reproducibly: the same image, the same variables, the same result.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: What begins where many stop: fixing, evolving, keeping dependencies current.
